golden.about: The live-trace session: metronome on, 2-bar loop at 120 BPM; a recorded take (Vocals track, beep train trimmed by 0.5 s) across the loop, a dropped library sample (instrument-less audio track) on bar 2, 808 drums and an Oracle synth line on beats 1 and 3. Offline it shows the bounce has no metronome, with a stem per track.
